name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention; '30' is chapter ID 30 (valid range 01-30), a meaningful domain ID, not an address residue (own address is 0x25757). '_end' is the descriptor for the chapter end-handler. Name accurately reflects purpose (Chapter 30 GOOD-ENDING end handler).
purpose: Chapter 30 end handler (the FD2 GOOD ENDING): plays the final-boss death cutscene, advances to the out-of-range chapter 31 epilogue map, runs the epilogue dialog, plays the staff-roll cinematic, then hard-locks in an infinite loop where the game terminates.
logic_summary: Copies three private 20-byte end-scene tables (pos_x/pos_y/facing, slots 0..0x13) onto stack scratch, then places the cast and re-aims the camera via fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro. Runs dialog page 9, cutscene event 0x58, dialog page 10; pans cursor/window to (0x10,0x12) and animates the cursor to tile (0x16,0x17). Plays the final-boss death visual: a screen-wide spell at (cursor_screen_x, cursor_screen_y+1) and a full HP/MP restore. Advances current_chapter_id to 31 (epilogue index), restores HP/MP again, resets battle_anim_phase, and loads the chapter 31 epilogue map via fd2_load_chapter_battle_data. Re-centres the battle window/cursor at world (0xB,5) with cursor_screen (0,0), composites one frame, then runs a 64-step palette fade-in (brightness 0x3E->0, 4ms/step) and a 40-frame composite hold (1 BIOS tick each). Shows epilogue dialog page 0, pans cursor/window to (0xB,0xC), runs cutscene 0x59, shows epilogue dialog page 1, then plays fd2_play_game_ending_cinematic (staff roll) and enters an infinite empty loop.

returns.semantics: No return value. The function never returns to its dispatcher: after the staff-roll cinematic it enters an unconditional infinite loop, ending the game.
